Images.Caption: A muscle car drives along a lonely road.
An abandoned town, a lonely police car sits in an otherwise empty parking lot.
A woman stands beneath a street lamp at night. Nearby, a huge insectoid creature approaches.
An adventurer stands near an empty swimming pool.
A map shows the layout of the game world, highlighting the player's location.  The map is surrounded by sundry items including a crow bar and coffee mug.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu—a survival-horror road trip through a nightmare version of 1980s Americana. Scavenge, fight, and sneak your way across small towns and eerie highways as reality begins to unravel.

Play as Hearst, a wayward traveler searching for their missing parents—and answers—in a world collapsing under the weight of something ancient and wrong. Trust is your most valuable resource, and you’ll need to rely on others to survive. Evade the police. Protect those around you. And help stop a violent, paranoid man whose delusions are putting everyone at risk—including his own children.

You didn’t grow up here. You don’t know the streets, the faces, or the things people see after dark. All you have is a strange letter, with no return address, and a growing sense that something’s gone terribly wrong.

Your parents live out this way. Or lived. You haven’t heard from them in too long. Now there’s smoke on the horizon and strange news on the wind.

You came to find your family. You came to understand what’s happening. If you don’t keep moving, you won’t get the chance to do either.

Something stirs beneath the pavement.

LocalizedProperties.MinimumNotes: OS: Windows 10 64-bit;Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200;Memory: 8 GB RAM;Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon R9 270X / RX 460 (2–4 GB VRAM);DirectX: Version 11 or 12;Storage: 5 GB available space (10 GB recommended during installation);Additional Notes: supports keyboard and mouse or Xbox controller.
LocalizedProperties.RecommendedNotes: OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit;Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600;Memory: 16 GB RAM;Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 / 6700 XT (6–12 GB VRAM);DirectX: Version 12;Storage: SSD with 5 GB available space (10 GB recommended during installation)
